alert.title: IMPORTANT WARNING: THIS IS AN EXPERIMENTAL PRODUCT – NOT FOR MEDICAL EMERGENCIES
alert.body: HealthSense is a research and experimental AI technology platform for heart rate monitoring and atrial fibrillation (AFib) screening. The system is NOT a medical facility, has NO automatic emergency function and does NOT REPLACE an in-person diagnosis by a cardiologist. If you experience chest pain, shortness of breath, dizziness or signs of a stroke, call Emergency 115 immediately or go to the nearest hospital.

s1.title: 1. Experimental nature and purpose of the platform
s1.articleTitle: ARTICLE 1. EXPERIMENTAL NATURE AND PURPOSE OF THE PLATFORM

clauses.c1: 1.1. Technological purpose: HealthSense is a digital platform currently in the research and experimental stage of medical technology (Experimental Beta/Pilot). The project aims to study the feasibility of continuously acquiring PPG/ECG signals from smart wearable devices in order to calculate 16 heart rate variability (HRV) metrics and to support the early identification of arrhythmia risk (atrial fibrillation – AFib).
clauses.c2: 1.2. Experimental nature: As an experimental research product, all features, interfaces and algorithms may be adjusted, upgraded or suspended for research purposes without being subject to any penalty or mandatory commercial obligation.

clauses.c1: 2.1. Not a medical diagnosis: All information, charts, AFib risk scores, sleep staging and reports generated by HealthSense are for personal reference and academic research only. The results do not replace a hospital-standard 12-lead clinical electrocardiogram (Holter ECG) or the orders of a cardiologist.
clauses.c2: 2.2. No self-directed changes to medical treatment: Users must under no circumstances rely on HealthSense results to buy medication, stop medication, or change the dosage of cardiac medications, anticoagulants or any treatment regimen on their own without the approval of their treating physician.
clauses.c3: 2.3. Online doctor consultations: All online communication through the platform is intended only as initial health guidance and does not replace an in-person examination at a licensed medical facility.

clauses.c1: 3.1. No automatic emergency connection: HealthSense has no technical connection to the 115 ambulance system or to any emergency response center. Heart rate alerts are intended only to help users monitor themselves.
clauses.c2: 3.2. What to do in case of dangerous symptoms: If symptoms occur such as chest pain radiating to the shoulder/arm, shortness of breath, severe dizziness, cold sweats, fainting, loss of consciousness or a suspected stroke, the User or their relatives must immediately call the 115 Emergency Hotline or go to the nearest hospital.

s4.title: 4. Accuracy and hardware device error
s4.articleTitle: ARTICLE 4. ACCURACY AND HARDWARE DEVICE ERROR

clauses.c1: 4.1. Signal noise & hardware error: PPG/ECG signals from smartwatches/smart bands depend directly on the optical sensor, strap tightness, vigorous movement, sweat, skin tone and humidity, and may therefore produce measurement errors or false alarms (false positives / false negatives).
clauses.c2: 4.2. No guarantee of 100% accuracy: Although the AI model has been trained on internationally recognized medical databases (MIMIC-III / PhysioNet) with high experimental accuracy, the Development Team makes no express or implied warranty that the system will detect 100% of all arrhythmia episodes in every real-world situation.

s5.title: 5. Privacy and health data security
s5.articleTitle: ARTICLE 5. PRIVACY AND HEALTH DATA SECURITY

clauses.c1: 5.1. Secure data encryption: Health data (heart rate, HRV, measurement logs) is transmitted over securely encrypted HTTPS/TLS and stored under strict role-based access control (RBAC).
clauses.c2: 5.2. Data anonymization for research: For the purpose of improving AI algorithms for detecting heart disease, the User agrees to allow the system to remove personal identifiers (De-identified / Anonymized) from measurement data for use in academic research in accordance with biomedical research ethics standards.

clauses.c1: 6.1. Provide truthful information: Provide accurate anthropometric information, age, sex and medical history to help the AI algorithm set the most appropriate alert thresholds.
clauses.c2: 6.2. Personal account security: Take responsibility for protecting your password and personal login account, and do not share access with any third party without authorization.
clauses.c3: 6.3. Follow technical instructions: Wear the device as instructed by the hardware manufacturer to ensure good sensor-to-skin contact and reliable measurement data.

s7.title: 7. Maximum limitation of legal liability
s7.articleTitle: ARTICLE 7. MAXIMUM LIMITATION OF LEGAL LIABILITY

clauses.c1: 7.1. Exemption for health events: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the founding team, researchers, software engineers, academic supervisors and the managing organization of HealthSense are fully exempt from all civil and criminal liability and from liability for direct/indirect damages in connection with any medical incident, bodily injury, cardiovascular event or death of the User.
clauses.c2: 7.2. Exemption for personal treatment decisions: Exemption from all losses or claims arising from the User making their own medical diagnosis or treatment decisions based solely on the parameters displayed by the platform.
clauses.c3: 7.3. Exemption for third-party technical incidents: Exemption from all Internet connection interruptions, Bluetooth/BLE synchronization losses or hardware failures of third-party wearable devices.

clauses.c1: 8.1. Effective date: This document takes effect from the moment the User registers an account, connects a wearable device or uses any feature of HealthSense.
clauses.c2: 8.2. Voluntary commitment: By registering an account or continuing to use the service, the User confirms that they are at least 18 years old (or have a legal guardian), have read and fully understood the experimental nature of the platform, and entirely voluntarily agree to comply with all of these terms.
clauses.c3: 8.3. Updates to the terms: The Development Team reserves the right to update or amend these regulations at each stage of the scientific research. Important updates will be publicly announced on the website.

emergencySymptoms.chestPain: Chest pain or a feeling of pressure in the chest
emergencySymptoms.breathlessness: Difficulty breathing, rapid breathing, sudden shortness of breath
emergencySymptoms.fainting: Fainting, sudden dizziness or loss of balance
emergencySymptoms.strokeSigns: Numbness or weakness on one side of the body, difficulty speaking (signs of stroke)
emergencySymptoms.palpitations: Persistent pounding heartbeat with cold sweats

document.specialTitle: ⚠️ SPECIAL PROVISION: DOES NOT REPLACE MEDICAL DIAGNOSIS OR EMERGENCY CARE
document.specialBody: HealthSense is an experimental digital project supporting health research. All notifications, metrics, AFib alerts and cardiovascular scores generated by computer algorithms are for reference only. The system is in no way a medical diagnostic device, must not be used as a substitute for a doctor and has no emergency response capability in urgent situations.
